item.text:
Implemented — the page now renders a fresh server timestamp on every request.

- Updated `app/page.tsx:1` to import `connection` from `next/server`.
- Made the page component async in `app/page.tsx:3` and added `await connection()` in `app/page.tsx:4` to opt out of static prerendering using Next.js’s recommended dynamic approach (without cookies/headers).
- Added per-request timestamp generation via `new Date().toISOString()` in `app/page.tsx:5`.
- Updated UI text to display the value in `app/page.tsx:9` and `app/page.tsx:10`.

If you want, I can also format the timestamp in a human-readable/localized form.
